verdicts.reason: A keeps the original layering, with the green circle bleeding off the top-right behind the bag. The headline is large and dominant, but it wraps to leave 'fizz' orphaned on its own line, and the gap between headline and CTA is tight compared with the space above. B shrinks the wordmark, headline and especially the CTA label, which becomes tiny and hard to read. It also strands both circles as floating blobs in the bottom third, so dead space opens around the headline and the bleed-off-edge feel of the original is lost.
